name: Codex Compatibility
description: Codex-compatible tool profile and apply_patch support for GPT coding models.

modelProfiles.title: Codex Compatible
modelProfiles.description: Codex-shaped runtime behavior for GPT coding models.

tools.name: apply_patch
tools.title: Apply Patch
tools.description: Apply a Codex-style patch. Supports Add File, Update File, Delete File, and Move to when present in the patch.
tools.promptSnippet: Apply Codex-style patches for file changes, including creating new files.
promptGuidelines: Use apply_patch for repository file changes.

tools.title: Write
tools.description: Write content to a file. Creates the file if it doesn't exist, overwrites if it does. Automatically creates parent directories.
promptGuidelines: Use write only for new files or complete rewrites.

path.description: Path to the file to write (relative or absolute)

content.description: Content to write to the file

tools.title: Edit
tools.description: OpenAI-only patch-based replacement for the built-in edit tool. Accepts either { patch } or the legacy { path, edits } shape.
tools.promptSnippet: edit: patch-based file edits; prefer a complete patch string for multi-line changes.
promptGuidelines: This edit tool accepts Codex-style patches via the patch field; prefer that over exact oldText replacement for non-trivial changes.

path.description: Legacy edit path. Used only with edits.
